name: DtlConfirmTag
meaning: DaffyTrainingLevel.confirmTag (+0xb1): the yes/no box asked after a help line (ParseTextTags, Update talk mode)

name: DTL_CONFIRM_NONE
meaning: no box: the line has no $CONF$ tag (and after an answer)

name: DTL_CONFIRM_AFTER_LINE
meaning: the line has a $CONF$ tag: ask when it has been said

name: DTL_CONFIRM_ASKING
meaning: the box is up; talk mode draws it and waits for the confirm button
